links.outcome: Semantic similarity stability of LLM summaries across repeated generations and sampling temperatures
links.effect: High consistency across repeated runs, cosine similarities typically exceeding 0.90; higher sampling temperatures reduced semantic similarity.
links.quote: Stability analysis showed high consistency across repeated runs, with cosine similarities typically exceeding 0.90, while higher sampling temperatures reduced semantic similarity.

unlisted_practices: Reference-free embedding-based semantic similarity scoring of LLM summaries against source transcripts for model selection

screen.reason: Evaluates a reference-free framework (embedding similarity, stability analysis, and human evaluation) to benchmark and safeguard the selection and optimization of local LLMs for post-processing medical transcriptions.

primary.practice: reference-free embedding-based evaluation and stability benchmarking for local model selection
